description: Lipobox usage and signal peptide length of the 77 candidate lipoproteins in HTA426
code:
import json, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
lp = pd.read_csv("gka_lipoprotein_candidates.csv")
lp["uacc"] = lp.acc.str.split("|").str[1]
lp["gene"] = lp.acc.str.extract(r"GN=(\S+)")
lp["name"] = lp.acc.str.split("|").str[2].str.split(" OS=").str[0].str.split("_").str[1:].str.join("_")
lp["desc"] = lp.acc.str.extract(r"_GEOKA (.+?) OS=")

print("GK0272 (Q5L3C3) a lipobox candidate:", "Q5L3C3" in set(lp.uacc))
print("GK2189 LhaT a lipobox candidate:", "Q5KXW2" in set(lp.uacc))
print("total candidates:", len(lp))
print(lp.gene.str.startswith("GK02").sum(), "candidates with GK02xx tags")

# Chain-length context: how long is the Lgt/LspA/LhaT substrate pool versus B. subtilis?
# B. subtilis has ~110 predicted lipoproteins out of 4237 (2.6%); same scan cannot be run
# here without that proteome, so report only the HTA426 number.
counts = lp.lipobox.value_counts()

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12.5, 4.4))
ax = axes[0]
ax.bar(counts.index[:12], counts.values[:12], color="#2f6f9f")
ax.set_xlabel("lipobox tetrapeptide (positions -3 to +1)")
ax.set_ylabel("candidate lipoproteins")
ax.set_title("HTA426 lipobox usage, 77 candidates in 3516 proteins (2.2 %)", fontsize=10)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=60, labelsize=8)

ax = axes[1]
ax.hist(lp.cys_pos, bins=np.arange(14, 41, 1), color="#c47a1a", edgecolor="white")
ax.set_xlabel("position of the lipidated cysteine")
ax.set_ylabel("candidate lipoproteins")
ax.set_title("Signal peptide length of the candidate pool", fontsize=10)
plt.suptitle("A substrate pool exists for the lipoprotein route: Lgt GK3081, LspA GK1145, LhaT GK2189", fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
